turns.response_html:
Count Chocula is a chocolate-flavored cereal featuring marshmallow pieces shaped like bats. Produced by General Mills, it is the most popular brand in their Monster Cereal line and is typically sold as a seasonal item around Halloween.

Would you like me to find out if any stores near Ames currently have it in stock?
